fields.Property Note:
This sale is subject to any unpaid taxes and assessments, tax, water, and so liens and other municipal assessments, including, but not limited to, certificate of sale 23–00009 sold on October 19, 2023 within approximate redemption amount of $43,109.40 as of January 15, 2026. The amount due can be obtained from the local tax authority. Pursuant to N.J.S.A.46:8B –21 to sale may also be subject to the limited lien priority of any condominium /homeowner association liens, which may exist.
All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so, the current amount due thereon. If the sale is set aside for any reason, the purchaser at the sale shall only be entitled to a return of the deposit paid. The purchaser shall have no further recourse against the mortgagee or the mortgagee’s attorneys.
Additional requirements: purchaser must certify that the purchaser is not employed by the Toronto – Dominion bank, or any of it subsidiaries or affiliate corporations (the “bank”), north is the purchaser related in anyway with the solicitors or agents retained by or on behalf of the bank in relation to the property that is subject of this transaction and confirming that purchaser is dealing at arm’s-length with the aforementioned parties
